targeted_failure_mode: Tiny/thin-object misses and associated localization weakness; not all baseline failures.

single_primary_change.scope: Same scalar input-size setting for training and its validation; all other numerical settings held fixed.

supporting_evidence: Tiny recall 28.1% versus large 57.2%; <4-pixel minimum side recall 6.9%.
Tiny Breakage recall 2.4%; small Breakage 26.1% versus medium 41.2%. Tiny Reinforcement 28.1% versus small 59.5%.
8622 Hole target ~6.9x8.3 px and 9217 reinforcement target ~2.0x16.6 px lose visible spatial detail at 640.
Tiny+small are 45.4% of diagnostic FN. Small overall recall matches medium; this is a targeted hypothesis, not proof that higher resolution improves the whole task.

intentionally_unchanged.dataset: GYU-DET V3 baseline-v1, exact existing membership and original labels
intentionally_unchanged.initialization: Official pretrained yolo26s.pt, SHA-256 646f8bc3fe0a656803d95c294f7852321748cb29d13466a1af8862e2db384a1b; fresh run, not baseline best.pt fine-tuning
intentionally_unchanged.optimizer: SGD Nesterov; lr0=.01 lrf=.01 momentum=.937 weight_decay=.0005; linear 100-epoch schedule
intentionally_unchanged.training: batch=4, nbs=64, accumulate=16 after warmup, max_epochs=100, patience=30, BF16, workers=0, cache=false
intentionally_unchanged.augmentations: All resolved baseline values identical, including mosaic=1, close_mosaic=10, scale=.5, HSV and flips; Albumentations disabled
intentionally_unchanged.evaluation: validation only; batch=8 FP16, conf=.001 iou=.7 max_det=300 nms=false; same evaluator and best-epoch selection
intentionally_unchanged.test_policy: Held-out test blocked; never used for tuning/selection
intentionally_unchanged.packages_and_hardware: Same recorded versions, Laptop 1 and GPU; no automatic batch fallback

scientific_comparison: Compare the baseline 640-input pipeline with the otherwise identical 800-input pipeline, selecting each best epoch by validation mAP50-95. This estimates the complete input-resolution-setting effect; it does not isolate training representation from inference-resolution benefit. One seed is a controlled comparison, not a variance estimate.

runtime.basis: Unbenchmarked pixel-area scaling from this Laptop 1 run. CPU/raw decoding, thermal state and early stopping can change scaling; estimate is not measured.

monday_feasibility.decision: Do not start for Monday. Keep DET-BASELINE as the presentation baseline and defer this proposal for authorization after the deadline.
monday_feasibility.reason: Even the 32-hour planning lower bound extends beyond Monday at the current Sunday-evening assessment, before reporting/integration reserve.

shorter_valid_experiment.limited_diagnostic: A separately authorized paired 640-vs-800 validation inference of the same frozen best.pt could test inference-time sensitivity in minutes plus review. It cannot establish the retrained DET-IMPROVED result and was not performed here.
shorter_valid_experiment.short_training: A truncated run or baseline-checkpoint fine-tune changes schedule/history and cannot stand in for the full comparison. A paired equal-budget pilot would be a different, separately approved two-arm experiment; none is proposed for execution now.

validation_success.recall_measurement: Same M1 bins; frozen confidence 0.18618618618618618, IoU>=.5 diagnostic matcher and same validation membership. No deployment threshold optimization.
validation_success.policy: Require both primary AP improvement and targeted recall gain; do not select on a favorable isolated number.

per_class_success.guardrail: No class AP50-95 decrease greater than 0.02 absolute from replay baseline; report all six classes and all size strata.
per_class_success.target: Report tiny Reinforcement and small Breakage recall gains explicitly; Hole AP75 should not decrease by >0.02. Tiny Breakage/Crack sample counts are small; do not promote on those alone.

stop_rollback.engineering: Stop on checkpoint/data identity mismatch, nonfinite behavior, guard violation, OOM/fixed-batch auto-reduction, or output collision. Never rewrite baseline evidence.
stop_rollback.scientific: Use unchanged patience=30/max_epochs=100. If success conditions fail, retain DET-BASELINE and document failure; no follow-on sweep or post-hoc threshold rescue.
stop_rollback.deadline: No start before Monday presentation under present timing. Do not shorten the canonical schedule to force a result.

risks: 800 may still leave a ~2-pixel target only ~2.5 pixels wide; benefit can be small.
Higher input cost/latency and VRAM; resource feasibility is not established by the area estimate.
Changes effective pixel geometry of unchanged relative augmentations.
No guarantee of benefit for Seepage or ambiguous labels; overfitting can persist.
Validation selection bias, class imbalance, source correlation and single-seed uncertainty remain.
implementation_note: Proposal only. Existing frozen training config validator restricts imgsz=640; any future authorized 800 change must be explicit and reviewed. No training/config code changed by this task.
